headerDisplay:
## Hubspace Platform

Sign in with your Hubspace (Home Depot) account. Tokens are cached locally — you will **not** be re-prompted on every restart.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/ctrlcmdshft/homebridge-hubspace-platform#readme) for full documentation and troubleshooting tips.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll device state as a fallback (10–600 s). When omitted, the plugin uses 300 s with Conclave enabled or 30 s when Conclave is disabled. Set a lower value if a device does not reliably emit push events.

tokenCachePath.title: Token Cache Path (advanced)
tokenCachePath.description: Override the path for the cached auth token file. Leave blank to use the Homebridge storage directory (recommended).

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging
debug.description: Log API calls, token refreshes, Conclave push details, unsupported-device capability summaries, and device discovery decisions. Enable temporarily while troubleshooting.

verbose.title: Enable Verbose Logging
verbose.description: Log every device state value on each update. Very noisy; use only when gathering data for a bug report or new device support request. Implies debug.

exposeComfortBreeze.title: Expose Comfort Breeze Switch
exposeComfortBreeze.description: Show Comfort Breeze as a separate HomeKit switch tile for supported fans. When disabled (default), Comfort Breeze is hidden and the fan tile tap toggles power directly.

exposeMasterPowerSwitch.title: Expose Master Power Switch
exposeMasterPowerSwitch.description: Show the ceiling-fan master power (power[primary]) as a separate HomeKit switch tile. Only applies to fans that have a dedicated fan-power field alongside a master power field.

exposeStatusFault.title: Expose Status Fault on Fans and Lights
exposeStatusFault.description: Add a non-standard fault indicator to fan and light services when Hubspace reports the device offline. Visible in third-party HomeKit apps such as Eve or Controller for HomeKit; Apple Home may not display it.

invertOutletStatus.title: Invert Outlet Status
invertOutletStatus.description: Invert the reported on/off state for outlets and plugs. Enable if your outlet appears on in HomeKit when it is physically off.

disableConclave.title: Disable Conclave Push
disableConclave.description: Disable the real-time Conclave push connection and fall back to polling only. Use this if you experience persistent connection issues.

excludedDevices.title: Excluded Devices
excludedDevices.description: Comma-separated Hubspace friendly names to hide from HomeKit, matched case-insensitively. Useful for duplicate devices, unwanted sub-devices, or devices managed by another plugin.
